rules.title: A claim names the command that produced it
rules.text: A number or a verdict in a document names the command that produced it; an unbacked claim is indistinguishable from a wrong one.

judgement.question: Does this line state a result the document backs with the command that produced it, or is it a verdict the reader has to trust?

criteria.true: the line asserts a result and names no command, harness or probe that produced it
criteria.false: the command, harness or probe is named on the line, or the line is not a claim about a result
